audience: A 27-year-old who loves how lipstick looks but reaches for lip balm every morning, because lipstick feels like dressing up.
insight: Lipstick is the skinny jeans of the makeup bag: great in photos, off the second you get home. So most days you reach for balm instead.
device: a garment care label sewn into the top of the frame: the lipstick is labelled like your favourite sweatpants (front: name, back: composition, size: shades), ending on a price hang tag
device_why: the brand's own line compares Ultralip to sweatpants; a woven care label is how clothes tell you what they're made of, so the label delivers the proof (balm + gloss + tint) in the metaphor's own language

recall.does: moisture of a balm, sheen of a gloss, colour of a tint
recall.why: lipstick as comfortable as sweatpants: you'll live in it

claims.text: the rich moisture of a balm, the sheen of a gloss and the buildable color of a lip tint
9 shades (Lucite, Pony, Cranberry, Cachet, Portrait, Ember, Villa, Crest, Flute)

music.title: Snooze
music.why: a slow, cosy R&B love song for a lipstick you never want to take off; the reel enters on a bar line 4.43 s into the 30 s preview so the chorus lift (19.54 s in the preview) lands on 'you'll live in it.'

look.why: the ground is a deep berry knit, the colour of the darker Ultralip shades; Glossier pink is the one accent, on the woven label and the price tag; white type

beats.shows: an extreme close-up of the Glossier tube swiping across her lips; on 'sweatpants.' a woven care label drops in at the neckline (Glossier. ULTRALIP) and the film settles under it
beats.serves: sets up the joke: lipstick that feels like comfy clothes

beats.shows: she holds the pink Ultralip tube up by her cheek; the label grows and its front reads the line
beats.serves: names the product and lands the brand's own line as the SMP

beats.shows: the label turns to its composition; each row lands with its proof: lips pressing soft, a glossy lip catching the light, a second swipe building colour
beats.serves: proves why it's comfortable AND still lipstick: three products' benefits in one

beats.shows: the label turns to SIZE; quick cuts of Ultralip going on four skin tones in four shades, ending on Glossier's product photo of the bullets standing together
beats.serves: sweatpants fit everyone: the range in the metaphor's terms

beats.shows: on the chorus lift the label turns to CARE (wear daily. live in it.); she laughs with the tube by her cheek, then a second woman turns, glossy lips
beats.serves: lands the SMP as a feeling: the lipstick you never take off

beats.shows: the Ultralip tube hero on the berry knit, a pink hang tag with the price, the Glossier. wordmark
beats.serves: what to buy, what it costs, where
